goals.0: Understanding the doctor's instructions: Trinken Sie viel Wasser
goals.1: Commands (Imperativ): Sie form and du form
goals.2: Talking about health: „Wie geht es dir?“
goals.3: Wishing someone who is ill well: Gute Besserung!
dialog.0.de.1.n: Wie geht es Ihnen? = How are you? (to a friend: Wie geht es dir?)
dialog.5.de.1.n: To a doctor: Herr Doktor / Frau Doktor
dialog.6.de.0.n: The usual wish to say to someone who is ill
grammar.0.title: Imperativ — commands and advice
grammar.0.note: Sie command: infinitive + Sie. du command: drop -en from the infinitive (Trink!). Verbs whose e changes to i keep the i: nehmen → Nimm!, essen → Iss!
grammar.1.intro: sollen — “should / (someone said) you have to”. Very common in a doctor's instructions.
grammar.1.note: Du sollst viel trinken. — The doctor has said you should drink plenty of water.
grammar.2.note: „Es geht.“ = It's so-so (not very good, not bad).
grammar.2.rows.0.0: Wie geht es dir? (to a friend)
grammar.2.rows.2.0: Say to someone who is ill
quiz.5.why: A du command: drop -en from the infinitive → Trink!
quiz.7.prompt: What do you say to a friend who is ill?
